zh.title: 馬來西亞航空集團承諾採購 10 架波音 787-10，另有 6 架選擇權
zh.summary: 馬來西亞航空集團選定波音 787-10 更新長程機隊，規劃從 2032 年起逐步替換現有的七架空中巴士 A350。
body: 馬來西亞航空集團與波音 11 月 25 日公布採購計畫，集團承諾採購 10 架 787-10，並取得另外 6 架的選擇權。波音表示，採購仍待最終確認。
馬來西亞航空集團計畫在 2032 年至 2035 年間逐步替換現有的七架空中巴士 A350，以更新馬來西亞航空的長程機隊。

en.title: Malaysia Aviation Group commits to 10 Boeing 787-10s with options for six more
en.summary: Malaysia Aviation Group has selected the 787 for its long-haul fleet renewal and plans to begin replacing its seven Airbus A350s in 2032.
body: Malaysia Aviation Group and Boeing announced a commitment for 10 Boeing 787-10 Dreamliners on November 25, with options for six more. Boeing said the purchase is subject to finalization.
Malaysia Aviation Group plans to phase out its seven Airbus A350s between 2032 and 2035 as it renews Malaysia Airlines’ long-haul fleet.

facts.claim: The commitment covers ten Boeing 787-10s and six additional aircraft options. Boeing says the purchase is subject to finalization.
The new jets are intended to replace seven A350s in phases from 2032 to 2035.

article.primarySource: 中央社 CNA 產經證券

zh.title: 易捷航空全年稅後獲利年減96% 執行長指中東衝突使航空業面臨挑戰
zh.summary: 易捷航空全年稅後獲利年減96%至2000萬英鎊；執行長指中東衝突影響航空業
body: 易捷航空透過聲明指出，截至今年9月底的12個月，公司稅後獲利較前一年減少96%，降至2000萬英鎊。全年營收成長6%，達107億英鎊。
易捷航空執行長 Kenton Jarvis 在全年財報聲明中表示，中東衝突及其對需求和燃油價格的影響，讓航空業今年面臨挑戰。公司燃油支出較前一年增加11%。
易捷航空股東本月以壓倒性票數，通過美國私募股權公司 Apollo 提出的57億英鎊收購案。兩家公司預期，交易若獲監管機關核可，將於明年初完成。

en.title: EasyJet annual after-tax profit falls 96%; CEO cites challenges from Middle East conflict
en.summary: EasyJet annual after-tax profit falls 96% to £20 million; CEO cites challenges from Middle East conflict.
body: EasyJet said in a statement that its after-tax profit fell 96% from a year earlier to £20 million in the 12 months to the end of September. Revenue rose 6% to £10.7 billion.

Chief executive Kenton Jarvis said in the annual results statement that the Middle East conflict and its effects on demand and fuel prices had made this year challenging for the aviation industry. EasyJet's fuel spending rose 11% compared with the previous year.

EasyJet shareholders voted overwhelmingly this month to approve a £5.7 billion takeover proposed by US private equity firm Apollo. The two companies expect the deal to close early next year if it receives regulatory approval.

zh.title: 挪威Norse Atlantic航空財務告急：須取得融資才能維持營運
zh.summary: 長程低成本航空公司Norse Atlantic航空11月25日公告財務狀況危急，須取得融資才能應付短期資金需求並繼續營運；奧斯陸證交所隨後將其股票列入Recovery Box。
body: 挪威長程低成本航空公司Norse Atlantic航空11月25日在奧斯陸證交所發布內線消息公告，表示公司財務狀況危急，必須取得融資才能應付短期流動資金需求並繼續營運。
公告指出，公司在顧問協助下評估多項策略選項，並與有意者就可能的收購進行討論；董事會與管理階層也考慮ACMI（濕租）合約等方案。公司同時與特定對象洽談短期融資，但表示無法保證談判能找到可行方案，將適時再公布進一步資訊。
公告後不到一小時，Euronext奧斯陸證交所以證券定價特別不確定為由，將Norse Atlantic股票列入Recovery Box特別分類，直到相關情況消除為止。
Norse Atlantic航空的機隊共有12架波音787。Travel Weekly報導，該公司今冬為P&O郵輪在加勒比海執飛包機，並將兩架飛機租給巴基斯坦國際航空，自營航班則包括倫敦蓋特威克（LGW）往返曼谷、普吉、開普敦和紐約。公告未提及航班異動。

en.title: Norse Atlantic Airways says its financial situation is critical, needs funding to keep flying
en.summary: Long-haul low-cost carrier Norse Atlantic Airways said on November 25 that its financial situation is critical and that it depends on new financing to meet short-term liquidity needs and continue operating. Euronext Oslo Børs then placed its shares in the Recovery Box.
body: Norwegian long-haul low-cost carrier Norse Atlantic Airways said in an inside-information announcement to the Oslo stock exchange on November 25 that its financial situation is critical and that it depends on securing financing to meet its short-term liquidity needs and continue operations.

The company said that, with its advisors, it has explored strategic alternatives and is in discussions about a potential takeover. The board and management have also considered other options, including ACMI contracts. Norse is in talks with selected parties on short-term financing, but said there can be no assurance those talks will produce a viable solution. It said it will provide further information when appropriate.
Less than an hour later, Euronext Oslo Børs placed Norse Atlantic in its Recovery Box, a compartment for securities whose pricing is particularly uncertain, until those circumstances no longer apply.

Norse Atlantic operates a fleet of 12 Boeing 787s. Travel Weekly reported that the airline is flying charters for P&O Cruises in the Caribbean this winter, leasing two aircraft to Pakistan International Airlines, and operating its own flights from London Gatwick (LGW) to Bangkok, Phuket, Cape Town and New York. The announcement did not mention any flight changes.

zh.title: 芝加哥奧黑爾機場（ORD）設備故障一度延誤到港航班　FAA 已解除地面管制
zh.summary: 芝加哥奧黑爾國際機場 11 月 24 日發生設備故障，美國聯邦航空總署一度要求部分飛往當地的航班暫留出發地，改採地面延誤計畫後於當天下午解除管制。
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）11 月 24 日下午一度要求部分飛往芝加哥奧黑爾國際機場（ORD）的航班暫留出發地，並非暫停奧黑爾機場所有航班起飛。FAA 隨後改採地面延誤計畫，讓部分飛往奧黑爾的班機延後起飛。NBC Chicago 報導，該計畫在芝加哥當地時間下午 5 時前後已取消。
FAA 向芝加哥 ABC7 證實，設備故障期間確有部分航班延誤。ABC7 報導，當地時間約下午 6 時，延誤情況已明顯減輕。FAA 的機場狀態頁只提供整體情況，旅客應向航空公司確認個別航班。

en.title: FAA lifts ground restrictions at Chicago O’Hare after equipment outage delays arrivals
en.summary: The FAA temporarily held some Chicago O’Hare-bound flights at their departure airports on November 24 after an equipment outage, then switched to a ground delay program that it canceled the same afternoon.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration briefly held some flights bound for Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD) at their departure airports on November 24. It did not halt all departures from O’Hare. The FAA then assigned later departure times to some inbound flights under a ground delay program. NBC Chicago reported the program was canceled by around 5 p.m. local time.

The FAA confirmed to Chicago’s ABC7 that some flights were delayed during the outage. ABC7 reported that delays had eased by about 6 p.m. local time. The FAA’s airport status page reports general conditions; passengers should check with their airline for individual flights.

facts.claim: The FAA lifted the ground stop for O’Hare-bound flights and then assigned later departure times under a ground delay program.
NBC Chicago reported that the ground delay program was canceled as of 5 p.m. Tuesday.
The FAA told ABC7 some flights were delayed during the equipment outage. Flights were still departing O’Hare during the stop, and ABC7 reported that delays were minimal by about 6 p.m.
The FAA airport status page lists general conditions and recommends checking with the airline for flight-specific information.
NBC Chicago originally published this event at 21:35:37 UTC on November 24.

zh.title: 歐盟航空安全總署改版EASA Pro首頁 個人化新聞改設專區
zh.summary: 歐盟航空安全總署改版EASA Pro首頁，個人化新聞另設專區，選單也已更新。
body: 歐盟航空安全總署（EASA）已重新設計航空專業人士網站 EASA Pro 的首頁，新版以較有條理的方式呈現該機構在不同航空領域的工作。
首頁也呈現重點計畫、最新消息與新聞稿。既有使用者熟悉的個人化功能仍可使用，個人化新聞串流則不再是首頁主軸，改設專屬區域。
已註冊使用者登入後，可在首頁該區域查看所關注主題的更新、出版品與活動。EASA 表示，網站選單也已更新，改善視覺對比與導覽，以支援使用輔助科技的使用者。

en.title: EASA redesigns EASA Pro homepage, gives personalised news its own area
en.summary: EASA redesigns the EASA Pro homepage, gives personalised news a dedicated area and updates navigation.
body: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) has redesigned the homepage of EASA Pro, its website for aviation professionals. The new page offers a more structured overview of the agency’s work across aviation domains.

It also highlights key initiatives, the latest news and press releases. EASA says existing users’ familiar personalisation features remain available, while the personalised news stream now has a dedicated area instead of being the homepage’s main feature.

Registered users can log in and navigate to that section of the homepage to access updates, publications and events related to the topics they follow. The website menu has also been updated, with improved visual contrast and navigation to better support users of assistive technologies.

zh.title: 美國航空與 Israir 簽合作協議，規劃 2027 年恢復紐約至特拉維夫航班
zh.summary: 美國航空計畫於 2027 年 3 月 27 日恢復紐約甘迺迪機場至特拉維夫的每日直飛，Israir 預計在這條航線實施共用班號。
body: 美國航空與以色列航空公司 Israir 簽署商業合作協議，將分階段擴大美國與以色列之間的銜接選項。美國航空計畫自 2027 年 3 月 27 日起，以波音 777-200ER 執飛紐約甘迺迪機場（JFK）至特拉維夫（TLV）的每日航班。
第一階段，Israir 預計在美國航空的紐約至特拉維夫航班掛上自家班號。雙方也將研擬聯運安排，讓 Israir 旅客在 JFK 轉接美國航空飛往美國各地、加拿大、拉丁美洲和加勒比海的航班。

en.title: American and Israir sign partnership ahead of planned JFK–Tel Aviv resumption
en.summary: American Airlines plans to resume daily JFK–Tel Aviv flights on March 27, 2027. Israir expects to add its code to the nonstop service.
body: American Airlines and Israeli carrier Israir have signed a commercial agreement to improve connections between Israel and the United States in phases. American plans to resume daily Boeing 777-200ER service between New York JFK (JFK) and Tel Aviv on March 27, 2027.

Initially, Israir expects to add its code to American’s JFK–Tel Aviv flights. The airlines will also work on an interline agreement for Israir customers connecting at JFK to American flights within the United States and to Canada, Latin America and the Caribbean.

facts.claim: American plans to resume daily JFK–Tel Aviv flights on March 27, 2027, on Boeing 777-200ER aircraft.
Israir expects to codeshare on American’s nonstop service, and the carriers intend to implement an interline agreement for onward travel from JFK.

zh.title: Plus Ultra 暫停最後航線
zh.summary: 西班牙航空公司Plus Ultra因重組暫停唯一航線，公司未來營運前景仍不明朗。
body: 路透社報導，西班牙航空公司Plus Ultra宣佈暫停其最後一條仍在營運的航線，作為重組的一環。航空公司表示，此次暫停旨在停止營運，同時檢視未來計畫。
最後航線的取消使Plus Ultra目前沒有任何活躍航班，對其短期營運前景帶來不確定性。該航空公司確認這標誌著其營運網絡的結束。
分析師指出，重組可能包括資產出售或尋求新投資者以恢復財務穩健，但公司短期前景仍不明朗。

en.title: Plus Ultra suspends final route
en.summary: Spanish carrier Plus Ultra suspends its only route amid restructuring, leaving its future uncertain.
body: Reuters reported that Spanish carrier Plus Ultra has suspended its last remaining scheduled route as part of a restructuring effort. The airline said the suspension is intended to halt operations while it reviews its future plans.

The cancellation of the final route leaves Plus Ultra with no active flights at present, creating uncertainty about its short‑term operational outlook. The carrier confirmed that this marks the end of its operational network.
Analysts note that the restructuring may involve asset sales or seeking new investors to restore financial stability, but the airline’s immediate prospects remain unclear.

zh.title: 聯合航空格陵蘭航班載客率僅46% 需求受限
zh.summary: 聯合航空格陵蘭航班載客率低，基礎設施與高旅費限制需求
body: 聯合航空經營罕見的北極航線飛往格陵蘭，根據 Simple Flying 的報導，航班的載客率僅為 46%，遠低於預期。
航空公司指出，低載客率主要源於格陵蘭的旅遊基礎設施有限，且度假成本高昂，這兩項因素共同抑制了旅客需求，使航班難以吸引足夠乘客。此外，旅客對於高昂的度假費用持保留態度，進一步削弱需求。
此情況突顯了在偏遠北極地區營運航線時，必須克服當地旅遊環境與成本的雙重障礙。

en.title: United Airlines' Greenland Flights Only 46% Full, Demand Limited
en.summary: United's Greenland flights are only 46% full, limited by infrastructure and high vacation costs
body: United Airlines operates rare Arctic flights to Greenland. Simple Flying reports that the load factor on these routes is only 46%, far below expectations.

The airline says the low occupancy stems from limited tourism infrastructure in Greenland and the high cost of vacation travel. These factors together suppress passenger demand, making it difficult for the flights to attract enough travelers. Moreover, travelers remain hesitant about the steep vacation expenses, further weakening demand.
The situation highlights the challenges of operating remote Arctic routes where local tourism facilities and costs present dual obstacles.

zh.title: 英國皇家空軍據報夜間將軍機移入遮蔽處 防範潛在無人機威脅
zh.summary: 英國皇家空軍據報夜間將軍機移入機庫與掩體，防範潛在無人機威脅。
body: 《泰晤士報》2026年11月25日報導，英國皇家空軍（RAF）正因無人機活動可能構成威脅，在夜間將基地內的軍機移入遮蔽處。
報導指出，軍機正於夜間移入機庫及加固掩體；皇家空軍也在架設Kevlar防無人機網，以保護室外易受威脅的裝備。
Sky News報導，這些防護網用於保護位於跑道附近或防護資源不足基地內的飛機。這類防護網據報在烏克蘭廣泛使用。

en.title: British Royal Air Force reportedly shelters aircraft overnight amid possible drone threat
en.summary: The RAF reportedly moves aircraft into hangars and hardened shelters overnight amid possible drone threats.
body: On November 25, 2026, The Times reported that the British Royal Air Force (RAF) is moving military aircraft at its bases under cover overnight because of the possible threat posed by drone activity.
The Times said the aircraft are being moved into hangars and hardened shelters at night. The Royal Air Force is also erecting Kevlar anti-drone nets to protect vulnerable platforms outside.
Sky News said the nets are being used to protect aircraft near runways or at bases that lack protective resources. The nets are also widely used in Ukraine, the report said.

zh.title: 烏克蘭稱攻擊俄羅斯空軍基地 5架軍機受損
zh.summary: 烏克蘭稱攻擊俄羅斯空軍基地，3架MiG-31及2架Su-34受損。
body: 烏克蘭表示，烏方攻擊俄羅斯Savasleyka空軍基地，造成3架MiG-31戰鬥機及2架Su-34戰鬥轟炸機受損。
Savasleyka空軍基地位於俄羅斯下諾夫哥羅德地區，地處莫斯科以東。烏克蘭參謀總部表示，這次攻擊發生於2026年11月24日及隔夜至25日的一系列打擊行動期間。
初步評估認為，這5架軍機將有一段時間無法飛行。軍方表示，此次攻擊造成的受損程度及受波及的軍機數量仍在評估中。

en.title: Ukraine says strike on Russian air base damaged five military jets
en.summary: Ukraine says its strike on a Russian air base damaged three MiG-31s and two Su-34s.
body: Ukraine said its strike on Russia’s Savasleyka air base damaged three MiG-31 fighters and two Su-34 fighter-bombers.

The Savasleyka air base is located in Russia’s Nizhny Novgorod region, to the east of Moscow. Ukraine’s General Staff said the attack took place during a series of strikes on November 24 and overnight into November 25, 2026.

The preliminary assessment indicated that all five of the aircraft would be unable to fly for some time. The military said it was still assessing the extent of the damage and the number of jets affected.

zh.title: 巴西航空工業與ALADA簽協議 推動KC-390與A-29政府間銷售
zh.summary: 巴西航空工業與ALADA簽框架協議，擬拓展拉美及非洲政府間銷售。
body: 巴西航空工業與巴西國營航太公司ALADA於2026年11月25日在巴西利亞的Mostra BID簽署框架協議，擬透過政府對政府採購模式，推動KC-390 Millennium與A-29 Super Tucano的銷售。
協議為評估及發展拉丁美洲與非洲的潛在商機訂出指引。2026年4月7日，智利聖地牙哥的FIDAE航展期間曾簽署一份諒解備忘錄，當時兩家公司開始探討政府對政府銷售機會。
ALADA受巴西國防部委託協助政府對政府銷售。當外國政府對巴西國防裝備表達興趣時，國防部可指派ALADA處理交易、簽署出口合約，並協助買方選擇巴西供應商。

en.title: Embraer and ALADA sign KC-390 and A-29 government-to-government sales framework
en.summary: Embraer and ALADA sign a framework for potential government-to-government sales in Latin America and Africa.
body: Embraer and Brazil’s state-owned aerospace company ALADA signed a framework agreement at Mostra BID in Brasília, Brazil, on November 25, 2026, to facilitate government-to-government sales of the KC-390 Millennium and A-29 Super Tucano.

The agreement sets guidelines for assessing and developing potential business opportunities in Latin America and Africa. A memorandum of understanding was signed at the FIDAE air show in Santiago, Chile, on April 7, 2026, when the two companies began exploring government-to-government sales opportunities.

ALADA has been tasked by Brazil’s Ministry of Defense with facilitating government-to-government sales. When a foreign government expresses interest in Brazilian defense equipment, the ministry can appoint ALADA to handle the transaction, sign export contracts and help the buyer select a Brazilian supplier.

zh.title: 巴基斯坦國際航空兩班英國航班取消，將改派自家波音 777
zh.summary: 巴基斯坦國際航空表示，濕租合作夥伴 Norse Atlantic 突然停止提供服務，兩班從英國出發的航班取消。航空公司計畫自 11 月 26 日起，由自家波音 777 機隊接手英國航班。
body: 巴基斯坦國際航空 11 月 25 日表示，倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）飛伊斯蘭馬巴德的 PK786，以及曼徹斯特機場（MAN）飛拉合爾的 PK710 航班取消。航空公司稱，旅客準備登機時才收到濕租合作夥伴 Norse Atlantic 停止服務的通知。
巴基斯坦國際航空宣布，將自 11 月 26 日起以自家波音 777 執飛英國航班。這次公布的是巴基斯坦國際航空的航班變更。

en.title: PIA cancels two UK flights and plans to switch to its own Boeing 777s
en.summary: Pakistan International Airlines says two UK departures were cancelled after wet-lease partner Norse Atlantic stopped providing service. PIA plans to assign its own Boeing 777s to UK flights from November 26.
body: Pakistan International Airlines said on November 25 that it cancelled PK786 from London Heathrow (LHR) to Islamabad and PK710 from Manchester (MAN) to Lahore. PIA said wet-lease partner Norse Atlantic notified it of the suspension as passengers were preparing to board.
PIA said it would assign its own Boeing 777 fleet to UK services beginning November 26. Under the previous wet-lease arrangement, Norse Atlantic provided the aircraft and crew.

zh.title: NASA 正式接收 X-59 超音速研究機，將繼續試飛
zh.summary: 美國國家航空暨太空總署已自洛克希德馬丁接收 X-59。NASA 將繼續試飛，研究如何降低陸上超音速飛行的音爆噪音。
body: 美國國家航空暨太空總署（NASA）11 月 23 日公布，已於 11 月 18 日正式取得 X-59 超音速研究機的所有權。交接前，洛克希德馬丁的 Skunk Works 團隊一直持有該機，並與 NASA 推進驗收審查。
X-59 於 2025 年 10 月首飛，之後以加州阿姆斯壯飛行研究中心為試飛基地。NASA 接手後將繼續試飛，洛克希德馬丁視需要提供支援。
NASA 的 Quesst 計畫將測量飛越時的噪音並蒐集民眾反應，供監管機關評估陸上民航超音速飛行的噪音標準。

en.title: NASA takes ownership of X-59 and will continue supersonic flight tests
en.summary: NASA has taken ownership of the X-59 from Lockheed Martin and will continue testing how to reduce the noise produced by supersonic flight over land.
body: NASA announced on November 23 that ownership of the X-59 aircraft transferred to the agency on November 18. Lockheed Martin’s Skunk Works team had retained ownership while working through an acceptance review with NASA.
The X-59 first flew in October 2025 and has since been based at Armstrong Flight Research Center in California. NASA will continue flight testing, with Lockheed Martin providing support as needed.

The Quesst mission will gather noise measurements and community responses to flyovers. NASA plans to share those results with regulators considering noise standards for civilian supersonic flight over land.

facts.claim: NASA took ownership from Lockheed Martin Skunk Works on November 18 after the acceptance review.

zh.title: 美國擬對巴西製飛機加徵10%關稅 巴西政府強烈反彈
zh.summary: 美國提議對巴西製飛機加徵10%關稅；巴西政府反彈並尋求協商
body: 美國政府提議對巴西製造的飛機加徵10%關稅。巴西政府強烈反彈，指控美方企圖藉關稅施壓，迫使巴西調整國內政策，並表示不會向此類威脅讓步。
美國貿易代表署（USTR）公佈的方案指出，美方認為巴西未充分回應華府對部分經貿議題的關切，因此建議修改先前依據「301條款」採取的措施，將原本獲豁免的巴西飛機納入課稅範圍。若新措施正式實施，巴西航空工業（Embraer）出口至美國的整架飛機將面臨額外10%關稅壓力。
巴西政府表示，將持續尋求透過協商解決爭端，但不排除在世界貿易組織（WTO）架構下採取法律行動，也保留依對等原則祭出反制措施的可能性。

en.title: U.S. Proposes Extra 10% Tariff on Brazilian-Made Aircraft; Brazil Objects
en.summary: U.S. proposes an extra 10% tariff on Brazilian-made aircraft; Brazil objects and seeks talks.
body: The U.S. government has proposed an additional 10% tariff on Brazilian-made aircraft. Brazil's government strongly objected, accusing Washington of using tariffs to pressure it to change domestic policies and saying it would not yield to such threats.

A plan published by the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) says Washington considers Brazil's response to some trade concerns inadequate and proposes amending Section 301 measures to include Brazilian aircraft that were previously exempt. If the new measures take effect, complete aircraft exported to the United States by Embraer would face an additional 10% tariff.

Brazil says it will continue seeking a negotiated settlement but has not ruled out legal action under the World Trade Organization (WTO) framework. It has also reserved the possibility of taking reciprocal countermeasures.

zh.title: GE Aerospace執行長宣佈$100,000捐款 支持軍人轉職航空維修培訓
zh.summary: GE Aerospace執行長宣佈$100,000捐款，將補助轉職軍人學費及考試費。
body: GE Aerospace董事長兼執行長Larry Culp在Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University的Daytona Beach校區宣佈一筆$100,000捐款，支持該校的航空維修技術SkillBridge計畫。這筆捐款將協助計畫中準備轉職的服役人員支付學費及聯邦航空總署（FAA）考試費。
GE Aerospace表示，SkillBridge讓準備離開軍隊的人員在服役的最後數月，透過參與計畫的企業與學校接受訓練，為投入民間職涯做準備。
GE Aerospace也指出，Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University在部分軍事基地開設一門一般航空維修課程，協助學員在離開軍隊前朝取得機體與動力裝置證照邁進。

en.title: GE Aerospace CEO announces $100,000 donation for service members' aviation training
en.summary: GE Aerospace's CEO announces a $100,000 donation to help transitioning service members cover tuition and testing costs.
body: GE Aerospace Chairman and CEO Larry Culp announced a $100,000 donation to Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University’s Aviation Maintenance Technology SkillBridge program at the university’s Daytona Beach campus. The donation will help cover tuition and Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) testing expenses for transitioning service members in the program, the company said.

The SkillBridge program allows service members transitioning out of the military to use their final months in uniform to train with participating companies and schools for civilian careers, according to GE Aerospace.

GE Aerospace said one Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University course offered at select military bases focuses on general aviation maintenance. It helps participants work toward an airframe and powerplant certification before leaving the military.

zh.title: 捷藍航空2026年最繁忙A320航線全在佛州 奧蘭多—聖胡安居冠
zh.summary: 根據Cirium數據，捷藍航空2026年最繁忙的A320航線是奧蘭多—聖胡安，全年雙向共3562班次；最繁忙的11條A320航線全數觸及佛州，反映該公司在精神航空退出後加速擴張佛州網絡。
body: 捷藍航空2026年最繁忙的空中巴士A320航線不是橫貫大陸的商務幹線，而是奧蘭多—聖胡安。根據Cirium數據，這條航線雙向全年共飛航3562班次、提供約57.3萬個座位，平均航程1189英里。更值得注意的是，最繁忙的11條A320城市對全數觸及佛州：勞德岱堡—拉瓜迪亞以3350班次居次，勞德岱堡—聖胡安以3280班次排名第三。

佛州擴張的直接推力是精神航空倒閉留下的缺口。捷藍7月宣布，夏季自勞德岱堡出發的班次接近每日130班，較2025年增加逾75%，目標是年底前達到每日約150班；按冬季班表計算，勞德岱堡已是捷藍起降班次最多的機場，約2.15萬班，高於一年前的約1.37萬班。機隊方面，截至2026年9月30日，A320佔捷藍298架飛機中的129架，而A220預計2027年交付7架、2028年9架、2029年10架、2030年2架。財務壓力仍在：捷藍第三季虧損2.57億美元，現金自2025年底的19.5億美元降至9月的12.6億美元，目標是2027年恢復持續獲利。

en.title: JetBlue's busiest A320 flights in 2026 all touch Florida
en.summary: Cirium data shows JetBlue's busiest Airbus A320 route in 2026 is Orlando–San Juan, with 3,562 flights in both directions, and all 11 of its busiest A320 city pairs touch Florida, reflecting the airline's rapid Florida expansion after Spirit Airlines' collapse.
body: JetBlue's busiest Airbus A320 route in 2026 is not a transcontinental link between two major business centres. According to Cirium, it is Orlando–San Juan, a leisure-heavy connection that recorded 3,562 flights in both directions, offering 572,976 seats across an average sector length of 1,189 miles. More revealing still, all 11 of the airline's busiest A320 city pairs touch Florida: Fort Lauderdale–LaGuardia follows with 3,350 combined flights and 542,688 seats, and Fort Lauderdale–San Juan with 3,280 flights and 531,288 seats.

The immediate catalyst is Spirit Airlines' collapse. JetBlue moved to fill part of the gap and said it intended to reach around 150 daily departures from Fort Lauderdale by year-end; its July announcement put summer departures near 130, more than 75% above 2025 levels. According to Simple Flying, citing Cirium schedule data, Fort Lauderdale is now JetBlue's busiest airport by scheduled departures, with roughly 21,500 winter departures against nearly 13,700 a year earlier. On fleet, the A320 accounts for 129 of JetBlue's 298 aircraft as of September 30, 2026, while its fleet plan lists seven A220 deliveries in 2027, nine in 2028, 10 in 2029, and two in 2030. The finances remain strained: the airline reported a third-quarter loss of $257 million, with cash falling from $1.95 billion at the end of 2025 to $1.26 billion in September, and it is targeting sustained profitability in 2027.

zh.title: 聯邦快遞MD-11貨機在邁阿密國際機場（MIA）衝出跑道 觸發FAA地面停飛措施
zh.summary: 聯邦快遞MD-11貨機於邁阿密國際機場（MIA）26R跑道衝出跑道，觸發FAA地面停飛。
body: 據AeroTime報導，一架聯邦快遞（FedEx Express）麥道MD-11貨機於2026年11月25日晚間，在邁阿密國際機場（MIA）降落時衝出跑道。這起事件發生在美國感恩節假期前夕，導致該機場四條跑道中的三條被迫關閉，並觸發美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）實施地面停飛措施。
美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）確認，涉事航機為聯邦快遞910號班機（FedEx Flight 910），該航班稍早從位於曼菲斯的Frederick W. Smith International Airport（MEM）起飛前往邁阿密。邁阿密機場官員進一步說明，該架貨機係在26R跑道降落時衝出跑道範圍。
在人員安全方面，Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office表示，這架聯邦快遞MD-11貨機上共有兩名人員，事發後並未傳出任何人員受傷的報告。
由於四條跑道中有三條因這起衝出跑道事件而關閉，邁阿密國際機場（MIA）的航班運作受到顯著影響，並觸發美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）的地面停飛措施。AeroTime報導指出，機場的航班中斷與延誤情況持續至2026年11月26日凌晨，FAA通報現場出現長達數小時的航班延誤。
在機隊背景方面，聯邦快遞於2026年5月才剛恢復MD-11機型的飛航運作。此前，美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）曾於2025年11月對該型機實施停飛令，直到2026年5月解除停飛令後，聯邦快遞才重新派遣MD-11貨機執飛任務。

en.title: FedEx MD-11 overruns runway at Miami International Airport (MIA), triggers FAA ground stop
en.summary: A FedEx Express MD-11 freighter overran Runway 26R at Miami International Airport (MIA), triggering an FAA ground stop.
body: A FedEx Express McDonnell Douglas MD-11 freighter overran a runway while landing at Miami International Airport (MIA) on the evening of November 25, 2026, according to a report published by AeroTime. The landing overrun occurred on the eve of the US Thanksgiving holiday, forcing the closure of three of the airport’s four runways and triggering a Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) ground stop.

In its identification of the aircraft, the FAA confirmed that the freighter was operating as FedEx Flight 910, which had departed from Frederick W. Smith International Airport (MEM) in Memphis. Miami airport officials stated that the aircraft overran Runway 26R while landing at the airport.

The Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office reported that two people were on board the McDonnell Douglas MD-11 freighter when the overrun occurred at Miami International Airport. According to the sheriff’s office, no injuries were reported as a result of the incident.

Because three of the four runways at Miami International Airport were forced to close following the overrun, the FAA ground stop had an immediate impact on traffic ahead of the US Thanksgiving holiday. AeroTime reported that operational disruptions continued into the early hours of November 26, 2026, with the FAA reporting delays of several hours.

The overrun also comes months after the cargo carrier returned the aircraft type to service. According to AeroTime, FedEx resumed MD-11 flights in May 2026 after the FAA lifted a grounding of the MD-11 aircraft type that had originally been imposed in November 2025.
